_note: TFRU loading screen HUD config. This file is NOT part of a scene: it drives the
chrome that sits on top of every scene - the top-left title, the bottom progress
bar and the tips line. The mod reads it once, at start-up, from
config/loadingscreen/loading_screen.json (written out with these defaults the
first time it is missing); it is never re-read while the game runs. Every field
is optional; delete one and the default below applies.
